subject: gk
question:
Which of the following was a provincial capital under the rule of Ashoka?

I. Taxila

II. Ujjain
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both I and II.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

The Mauryan Empire was divided into four provinces with the imperial capital at Pataliputra.

 
• From Ashokan edicts, the name of the four provincial capitals are
 
 
• Tosali (in the east),
 
• Ujjain (in the west),
 
• Suvarnagiri (in the south), and
 
• Taxila (in the north)
